audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed with their own prose: the chart said Skill at level 1 while whys[0] says you out-range him outright, said Heimerdinger at level 2 while whys[1] calls it a coin-flip, said Skill at 4-5 and 6 while whys[3] and whys[4] both describe him winning, and said Heimerdinger at 2+ items while whys[6] says the lane flips back to you.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Lucian. The mirror has already set its level 1 and 2+ items rows to that chart.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[1], win[3], win[4], win[6] flipped with their phases[N].side partners as one atomic group, ratings inverted, and the contradicting phases[N].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns or ranges anywhere, and the packet flags that the page never names a single Heimerdinger ability properly.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — it does not get shorter, which makes 'commit on its cooldown' a fixed, countable window rather than a guess. Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units against your 500-range Q; that gap is the entire lane.
audit.corrected: The 11s grenade and 1325 rocket range written into phases[2..5].why, whys[4], report[5].t, early and mid, with the full ability names used.

audit.whatIsWrong: early says 'Don't throw Q at him through the turrets — they soak it', and nothing anywhere mentions what Piercing Light actually does.
audit.why: Riot's text for Piercing Light: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light THROUGH a target. It does not stop on the first unit. So targeting a turret still lands the bolt on Heimerdinger standing behind it — the turret line is not the damage wall the page claims, and the current advice tells the reader to give up their only safe poke.
audit.corrected: The pierce written into early, wants.you[1] and report[5].t; the 'turrets soak it' claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Your Culling' appears in whys[4] and mid.
audit.why: The ability is The Culling. Flagged in packet suspectNames and confirmed against the kit file.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is the only window where you out-range him cleanly — before he has the full turret cluster, walk up and Q-into-Lightslinger double-tap him, because your auto range beats his body and the turrets aren't there yet to punish you. The second he plants three turrets, stop walking into the wave: that turret line plus his W rockets out-poke your Q and zone you off the minions. Don't throw Q at him through the turrets — they soak it and you just shove the wave under his zone. Bait his E grenade; it's his only hard CC and your whole all-in depends on it being down.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is the only window where you out-range him cleanly — before the full turret cluster exists, walk up and Q-into-Lightslinger double-tap him, because your auto range beats his body and nothing is planted yet to punish you. The second he lays three turrets, stop walking into the wave: that line plus 1325-range Hextech Micro-Rockets out-poke your 500-range Q. But Piercing Light fires THROUGH its target, so aim it at a turret and it still lands on Heimerdinger behind it. Bait the grenade; it is his only hard CC.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are his. With all three turrets up he owns the lane state — he can W-poke you, wall the wave, and his E stun catches your low base HP before E-Relentless Pursuit is back. At 6 your Culling is nearly useless here: the turret cluster body-blocks the barrage and he just E-stuns you mid-channel. Don't force the all-in into a planted turret field. Farm with Q tips from max range, hold E to dodge the grenade, and accept that you can't break his zone with abilities alone right now — wait for items and roam to a lane you can actually win.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are his. With all three turrets up he owns the lane state — Hextech Micro-Rockets poke from 1325, the turret line walls the wave, and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, a flat 11s at every rank, stuns your low base HP before Relentless Pursuit is back. At 6 The Culling is nearly useless: the cluster body-blocks the barrage and the grenade stuns you mid-channel. Don't force an all-in into a planted field. Farm with Q tips from max range, hold E for the grenade, and roam to a lane you can win.

notes: The page told the reader that turrets soak Piercing Light. They do not — Lucian's Q pierces THROUGH its target by Riot's own description, so a turret is a free anchor to hit Heimerdinger behind it. That single correction gives the matchup back its safe poke and is the most valuable line on the page. Five chart rows contradicted their own whys; flipped as one atomic group onto the packet chart, in line with the mirror. 'Your Culling' corrected in two places.
